seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: OPEN SEAT; CANDIDATE LIST NOT CONFIRMED BEYOND ONE SOURCE. Current CA-38 member Linda Sánchez is running in the redrawn 41st District (Ballotpedia News: Sánchez and Mitch Clemmons advanced there). Only the LA Almanac (search summary) gives the 38th general matchup, Hilda Solis (D) vs Pedro Antonio Casas (R). No AP call, SoS results, or certified-list entry with names was found. Primary candidates also included Monica Sanchez (D), backed by Linda Sánchez per Axios, and Thomas Adams-Falconer (per Ballotpedia's pre-primary list). Solis's earlier offices (for example, federal and state posts) are not included because they were not seen in a source during this run. No background was found for Casas. Biographical research is incomplete because the web-search budget ran out.
